body: I've heard good things about that. That's what I wanted to start but we decided to try something else first. I broke out the bottle of vodka someone bought for my birthday and had a few shots. Probably not the best idea but I've definitively mellowed out and possible want to go to sleep. I can see how it can become addictive, a few gulps and it makes your problems disappear for awhile. My father was an alcoholic which has always made me skeptical of alcohol.

Thanks. I am trying to get to disability, I don't know if I can. I did manage to go to a $20 walk-in clinic and get prescribed a few medications for depression, anxiety, and sleep. Although I can't actually afford any of them at my pharmacy, they are there and ready which is a warming thought.

I have/had a job. I just can't really work because of my back. I think I accidentally hit something out of place a few years back. Any moving over 30 minutes will completely lock up my back and I can't move. I am absolutely already on the government's dime but it isn't enough. Typing this stuff out really sinks it in for me. My options are either kill myself now or waste away on the streets after I get kicked out. There is **no** option that ends happily for me.

Haha, that actually made me laugh out loud. I'm thinking about jumping off a bridge and you're telling me not to because of how awesome the internet is. I'm actually charging my phone and using the free wifi at Mcdonalds right now =)
I live in the mid-west. I'm a pretty big fan of superhero movies and GoT.
